suite.name: Temperature Alarm HMI Verification
suite.doc: Hardware-in-the-Loop Verification Log for Element 2 Car Temperature Alarm HMI.

kw.name: Initialize HMI Hardware Environment
kw.msg: Verified Arduino UNO Rev3 power, 16x2 LCD keypad shield on A0, LM35 sensor on A1, buzzer on D2/PD2, and Red LED on D3/PD3.

kw.name: Execute Manual Step
kw.arg: Press the Arduino UNO Rev3 hardware RESET button and confirm both LCD rows render clearly.
kw.msg: OBSERVED PASS: 16x2 LCD initialized cleanly and displayed Temp, LL, LH, and status fields.

kw.name: Adjust Limit Button On Keypad
kw.msg: Configured bench verification window: LL=0 C, LH=30 C.

kw.name: Verify LCD Display Status
kw.msg: OBSERVED PASS: Lower LM35 reading inside 0-30 C displayed 'OK' on LCD with Red LED (PD3) OFF.

kw.name: Apply Sensor Temperature Stimulus
kw.msg: Warming LM35 sensor on A1 above LH=30 C.

kw.name: Verify Alert Outputs State
kw.msg: OBSERVED PASS: LM35 reading reached 43.6 C (> LH=30 C); LCD switched to 'NOT OKAY' and Red LED (PD3) turned ON. Buzzer audio scheduled for final demo video confirmation.

kw.name: Execute Manual Step
kw.arg: Verify buzzer audio, recovery to OK, below-LL trigger (25-30 C final range), boundary equality (LL/LH), limit guard (LL <= LH), and ~3 C room-temp scaling.
kw.msg: PENDING VIDEO RUN: Remaining corner cases and final 25-30 C range checks scheduled for live recording in video/demo_video.mp4.

errors.msg: PENDING VIDEO RUN: Remaining corner cases and final 25-30 C range checks scheduled for live recording in video/demo_video.mp4.
